profile.headline: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Fullstack Software Engineer with experience in Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React, PostgreSQL, SQL, HTML, CSS, Git, and Python. 

Software Engineer with background in operations and analytics. I fully embrace a life of continued learning and personal growth. I earned my MBA at Carnegie Mellon University - Tepper School of Business where I concentrated in Business Systems, Finance, and Operations Management. In my professional career, I spent more than nine years working in operations for companies such as Tesla and Uber, where I also got introduced to software development. I am currently chasing my long-time dream of becoming the best software engineer I can. I am skilled in Ruby, Rails, JavaScript, React, PostgreSQL, SQL, HTML, CSS, Git, and Python.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
● As the sole engineer, I was responsible for the end-to-end development of a complex web application for the Department of Defense - Naval Air Systems Command. This involves designing all backend models, views, and controllers using Python/Django and PostgreSQL, as well as developing a user-friendly interface using JavaScript/React. The application was deployed on PlatformOne and it enables the client to easily access critical data, run reports, and obtain valuable analytics
● Additionally, I designed and implemented a dashboard using Python and Streamlit for the Department of Defense - Physical Security Enterprise Analysis Group. This dashboard provided a real-time view of key metrics and allowed the client to quickly determine the number of express lanes required based on changing variables. The project required extensive collaboration with stakeholders to understand their needs and ensure that the dashboard was intuitive, accurate, and actionable.

positions.title: Senior Director, Technical Operations
positions.description:
● Used Python to automate manual tasks such as order processing, approvals, and exceptions 
● Redefined metrics and KPIs to better measure team’s performance

positions.title: Marketplace: Core Pricing - Senior Operations Manager
positions.description:
● Created a Python tool to redesign Uber’s pricing structure. The tool saved an estimated $500M per year
● Used SQL and dashboard building skills to design a monitoring tool that identified driver surge outages and saved about $20M 
● Developed a methodology for calculating incremental gross booking per unit of spend for all incentives, allowing Uber to compare the effectiveness of different driver incentives methods

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.description:
● Used Python to create an automated invoice processing tool that resulted in a decrease of the average accounts receivable turnover by 60 days and saved about $800K annually
● Designed a tool that optimized the fillers’ route and improved employee efficiency. The system also reduced batching time by 200 minutes per day

positions.title: Area Manager - Order Fulfillment
positions.description:
● Monitored workflow and managed allocation of human resources among 6 departments to maximize operational efficiency; created MS Access databases to assist supervisors with work distribution and manage operational needs 
● Reevaluated existing employee support system and implemented changes that led to approximately $200,000 in annual savings and work-in-process time reductions
● Created MS Access databases that helped track employee productivity and performance metrics that were widely used by company and evaluated to be worth over $400,000
● Responsible for documenting, tracking and reporting attendance for an 80-person operation; developed Excel VBA models to automate this process 
● Led and managed staff of 15 individuals; regularly coached team members and provided actionable and constructive feedback

positions.title: Area Manager - Sales Operations
positions.description:
● Developed Excel VBA model that helped employees properly send correction orders and provided the department with 100% accuracy when making shipping decisions
●  Redesigned company scheduling system that led to improvements in customer service
Initiated and identified opportunities to improve deliveries to Canada; worked closely with customers to complete implementation
● Designed and developed comprehensive reports that allowed management team to identify billing errors, duplicate orders, and transportation mistakes early in the process and resolve issues promptly before customers complained
● Created multiple managerial tools to allow review of aging customer orders to improve average delivery times, and pairing invoices with credits to allow for faster supplier payments

positions.title: Business Analyst
positions.description:
● Identified inefficiencies in the lumping process and proposed changes to the procedure that brought an additional $96,000 in revenue to the company
●  Used merchandising techniques such as forward buying, diverting, and truck-load buying to generate over $1MM in gross profit for the company over 4 months
● Assisted other merchandisers in multiple truck-load buys that cumulatively earned over $7MM in gross profit
● Performed detailed two-week audits, analyzing warehouse operations and product movements from vendor to customer
● Monitored pricing, performed routine market research, reviewed gross profit revenue streams, and analyzed year to year trends in gross profit performance

positions.title: Tutor and Teaching Assistant, Econometrics, Macroeconomics, Microeconomics
positions.description:
Provided assistance and support to students. Performed numerous multivariate regression
analyses with the use of computer programs such as EViews and STATA. Presented the
regression results to the students in both written and oral forms, often with the use of Excel
and PowerPoint. Graded problem sets and homework assignments. Worked one-on-one with
students that needed extra help.

positions.title: Campus Center Manager
positions.description:
Provided excellent customer service to all clients of the Campus Center. Collaborated with
multiple groups and organizations to plan, coordinate, and manage a variety of events at the
Campus Center. Teamed with the Assistant Director of Student Activities to develop and foster
a sense of campus community.
